description: Given Airflow on_failure_callback/on_success_callback, EmailOperator, or PagerdutyEventsHook notification patterns, author the matching Orchestra alerts: block — pipeline-level for default_args-scoped callbacks, task-level for a callback set on a single task — with the correct required field per destination type (destination for SLACK/EMAIL, connection_id for PAGER_DUTY/TEAMS/WEBHOOK/DATADOG).

evals.prompt: Convert this Airflow on_failure_callback to an Orchestra pipeline-level alert (see files/callback_multi_destination.py). It posts to the #incidents Slack channel and also pages PagerDuty on any task failure. Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live sends, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A pipeline-level alerts: entry firing on FAILED with two destinations: SLACK (destination: '#incidents', no connection_id field) and PAGER_DUTY (connection_id: pagerduty_prod_12345, no destination field), since default_args['on_failure_callback'] applies to the whole DAG.

assertions.text: The SLACK destination sets destination (SLACK/EMAIL require destination, not connection_id)
The PAGER_DUTY destination sets connection_id (PAGER_DUTY/TEAMS/WEBHOOK/DATADOG require connection_id)
The #incidents channel is carried over as the SLACK destination value
pagerduty_prod_12345 is carried over as the PAGER_DUTY connection_id
The alert is placed at the pipeline root, not on an individual task, since on_failure_callback is set in default_args and applies DAG-wide

evals.prompt: Convert this Airflow EmailOperator completion notification to an Orchestra pipeline-level alert (see files/email_completion_notification.py) — it should fire on success, not be left as a pipeline task. Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live sends, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A pipeline-level alerts: entry firing on SUCCEEDED with a single EMAIL destination (destination: 'data-team@example.com', no connection_id field), replacing the send_completion_email task entirely rather than keeping it as a pipeline step.

assertions.text: The EMAIL destination sets destination (SLACK/EMAIL require destination, not connection_id)
data-team@example.com is carried over as the EMAIL destination value
The EmailOperator task is converted into an alerts: destination rather than kept as a pipeline task, since its entire job is sending a completion notification

evals.prompt: Convert this Airflow on_failure_callback to an Orchestra task-level alert on the critical_load task only — it should not fire for the whole DAG (see files/pagerduty_hook_callback.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live paging, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A task-level alerts: entry on the critical-load task (not the pipeline root) firing on FAILED with a PAGER_DUTY destination (connection_id: pagerduty_oncall_67890, no destination field), since the callback is attached to that one task, not default_args.

assertions.text: pagerduty_oncall_67890 is carried over as the connection_id
The alert is placed on the critical-load TaskModel (task-level), not the pipeline root alerts: block — matching the task-scoped on_failure_callback rather than a DAG-wide default_args callback
stage_data and downstream_report, which have no callback, do not also get this alert
